newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Fahd held talks in Sauid Arabia with the Moslem chairman of Bosnia's collective presidency Alija Izetbegovic.
- Algeria launched direct shipping service to Saudi Arabia.
- Airline fare war on India sector flares up again.
- Saudi Arabia and Australia are in talks to boost commercial and investment cooperation.
- Malaysia's prime minister will visit Saudi Arabia on March 21.
- Saudi Arabia has plans to link the power grids of various areas. The first phase is to cost 600 million riyals.
- Al-Rajhi Banking and Investment is offering a trust fund to invest in Egyptian shares.
- Saudi foreign minister met his Iranian counterpart.
- Saudi defence minister ended visit to Britain.
- Saudi Basic Industries Corp is offering new 82 investment opportunities.
